description: This file defines a base activity class `SampleActivityBase` that extends `FragmentActivity`. It sets up logging functionality using a custom `LogWrapper` and provides lifecycle methods `onCreate` and `onStart`.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base activity class providing logging setup and lifecycle management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, currently only calls the superclass method.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Overrides the activity start lifecycle method to initialize logging.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the custom logging chain using LogWrapper.
